# Durability and immutability errors and warnings

Diagnostics reported by the analyzers that verify the [Durable] and [ImmutableType] contracts of compile-time code.

| Article | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| <xref:lama0870> | A field or property of a [Durable] type has a type that isn't durable. |
| <xref:lama0871> | A value that isn't durable is stored in a member marked [Durable]. |
| <xref:lama0872> | An argument that isn't durable is passed to a parameter marked [Durable]. |
| <xref:lama0873> | A [Durable] type derives from a base class that isn't durable. |
| <xref:lama0874> | A [Durable] attribute is applied to a type that already inherits the contract. |
| <xref:lama0875> | A weak-reference member of a durable type isn't named with the 'Dangerous' suffix. |
| <xref:lama0876> | A member of a durable type has an interface or abstract type that isn't marked [Durable]. |
| <xref:lama0877> | A [Durable] field or property can be assigned from outside the type that declares it. |
| <xref:lama0878> | A lambda used where a durable value is required captures a value that isn't durable. |
| <xref:lama0879> | A type name declared in MetalamaDurableType or MetalamaNonDurableType matches no type. |
| <xref:lama0880> | A field of an aspect, a fabric, or a validator is neither read-only nor private. |
| <xref:lama0881> | An automatic property of an aspect, a fabric, or a validator has a setter that isn't private. |
| <xref:lama0882> | A member of a type that must be immutable has a mutable type. |
| <xref:lama0883> | A type that must be immutable derives from a mutable base type. |
| <xref:lama0884> | A member of a type that must be immutable is typed as an unmarked interface or abstract type. |
| <xref:lama0885> | A type name declared as immutable in the project file matches no type. |
| <xref:lama0886> | An [ImmutableType] attribute is redundant because the type already inherits the contract. |
| <xref:lama0887> | A member of a type that must be immutable is assigned outside a constructor. |
| <xref:lama0888> | A member of a type that must be immutable is passed as an out argument outside a constructor. |
